annotation.summary_en: A woman returns from a trip to France and describes how everyone in her group was repeatedly assaulted, except for one specific companion who simply 'didn't want to.'
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins in a hallway where a young man in a blue shirt excitedly greets a character in a curly blonde wig and a white robe, who has just returned from a trip. The setting shifts to a cluttered, book-lined study or living room where the wigged character (a woman played by a male comedian in drag) sits smoking a cigarette and recounting her travels to Paris. She describes visiting the Champs-Élysées and meeting Gérard Depardieu in a restaurant, noting they were treated exceptionally well—until the end of the day when everyone in their group was raped, except for a woman named Gayane Samsonovna. The storytelling continues with a visit to the Eiffel Tower, where the same pattern repeats: a wonderful day followed by a mass assault at the top level, again sparing only Gayane. Finally, she describes a beautiful trip to Lyon with similar results. When the confused young man asks why everyone else was targeted while Gayane Samsonovna was left alone, the woman nonchalantly delivers the punchline: Gayane simply didn't want to participate.
